  tagline = 'Whose side are you on?',

  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Civil War: The Card Collector''s Dream

Captain America: Civil War (2016) is a card collector''s paradise — it features the MCU debuts of both Spider-Man (Tom Holland) and Black Panther (Chadwick Boseman), plus the entire Avengers roster. This film''s card sets contain some of the most valuable MCU cards ever produced.

### Key Sets

The **2016 Upper Deck Captain America: Civil War** set features an enormous cast of autograph signers. Tom Holland''s first MCU Spider-Man autograph and Chadwick Boseman''s Black Panther debut card are the crown jewels.

### Market Trends

Chadwick Boseman autograph cards have become some of the most valuable MCU cards following his passing in 2020. Tom Holland Spider-Man debut autos command premium prices. The sheer number of characters makes complete autograph sets nearly impossible to assemble.',
  keyCards = '- **Chadwick Boseman as Black Panther First Auto** — Tragically valuable following his passing ($10,000+)
- **Tom Holland as Spider-Man MCU Debut Auto** — First MCU Spider-Man card ($5,000+)
- **Robert Downey Jr. / Chris Evans Dual Auto** — Iron Man vs Cap dual-signed ($8,000+)
- **Daniel Bruhl as Zemo Autograph** — Underrated villain card ($400+)
- **Team Cap vs Team Iron Man Insert Set** — Faction-themed chase cards
- **2016 Upper Deck Civil War Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 battle artwork',
  content = '## The MCU''s Greatest Conflict

Captain America: Civil War is essentially Avengers 2.5 — a massive ensemble film that pits hero against hero in the MCU''s most emotionally devastating conflict. The Russo Brothers delivered a film that somehow balances 12+ major characters while introducing Spider-Man and Black Panther, and still finds time for genuine emotional depth.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced Spider-Man to the MCU** — Tom Holland''s debut in the airport scene became instantly iconic
- **Black Panther''s First Appearance** — Chadwick Boseman''s T''Challa debuted here before his solo film
- **Broke the Avengers** — The team split set up the emotional stakes for Infinity War
- **The Airport Battle** — One of the most spectacular action sequences in superhero cinema
- **Zemo** — A villain who won without superpowers, just by turning heroes against each other

## Fun Facts

- The airport battle sequence took 75 days to film and over a year of post-production
- Tom Holland was only 19 when cast as Spider-Man, making him the youngest actor in the role
- Chadwick Boseman did most of his own stunts in the Black Panther suit
- The film was originally going to be a smaller story before Marvel expanded it into an ensemble
- Robert Downey Jr. reportedly earned $40 million for his role

## Viewing Context

Captain America: Civil War is the **thirteenth MCU film** and the first entry in Phase 3. It directly follows Age of Ultron and The Winter Soldier, bringing the Avengers'' internal tensions to a breaking point. The Sokovia Accords and team split directly set up the stakes for Infinity War.',
  metaDescription = 'Captain America: Civil War (2016) — $1.15B box office, Spider-Man and Black Panther MCU debuts, and why this is the ultimate card collector''s film.',
  keywords = 'Captain America Civil War, MCU Phase 3, Spider-Man debut, Black Panther, Tom Holland, Chadwick Boseman, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Civil War cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Captain America: Civil War on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Captain America: Civil War (2016) is available on Disney+. It features the MCU debuts of Spider-Man (Tom Holland) and Black Panther (Chadwick Boseman)."},{"question":"How much did Civil War make?","answer":"Captain America: Civil War grossed $1.153 billion worldwide against a $250 million budget, earning $179 million opening weekend."},{"question":"Who is on Team Cap vs Team Iron Man?","answer":"Team Cap: Captain America, Falcon, Scarlet Witch, Hawkeye, Ant-Man, Winter Soldier. Team Iron Man: Iron Man, War Machine, Black Widow, Vision, Spider-Man, Black Panther."},{"question":"What Civil War cards are most valuable?","answer":"Chadwick Boseman Black Panther autos ($10,000+) are the most valuable following his passing. Tom Holland Spider-Man debut autos ($5,000+) and RDJ/Evans dual autos ($8,000+) are also premium."},{"question":"Is Civil War important to the MCU?","answer":"Absolutely — it introduces Spider-Man and Black Panther, breaks the Avengers apart (setting up Infinity War), and establishes the Sokovia Accords that affect the entire franchise going forward."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
